purpose: Run Chimera user-space tools and Aurora host integration on top of a supported 64-bit host OS without replacing its kernel.

support_policy.required_runtime: Python 3.10+ for the portable host bridge; C/C++ toolchain optional for native builds
support_policy.execution_claim: Hosted bridge and portable built-ins only; this file does not claim full guest OS virtualization or complete API/syscall emulation.
support_policy.guest_executables: Native execution requires the host OS loader and matching architecture. Cross-ISA execution requires a separately implemented and validated emulator/backend.

host_oses: 32-bit BSD/POSIX x86 where runtime remains available
limitations: cannot boot a 64-bit Koronos kernel on a 32-bit host
process address space is limited by the host OS
cross-ISA guest execution needs a validated backend

unsupported_combinations: 64-bit Chimera native kernel on a 32-bit host
32-bit macOS as a supported current target
support_policy.abi_rule: Host executable, shared-library and process ABI bitness must match; ISA inventory does not imply executable backend support.

windows_x64.windows_apis: compat/windows manifests and PE inspection; native PE runner is required for actual Windows binary execution when not already on Windows
windows_x64.desktop: Aurora host bridge can open files/URLs and launch host programs; full Aurora desktop remains a separate component

linux_x64.desktop: xdg-open integration when available; Aurora graphical runtime is separate

linux_arm64.desktop: xdg-open integration when available; Aurora graphical runtime is separate

unix_bsd64.desktop: platform opener where supported; compositor is separate

os: 64-bit macOS on Intel or Apple Silicon
macos64.desktop: open integration; native macOS security and application rules remain in force

command_compatibility.translation_policy: Translate a small documented command alias set; pass external commands as argument arrays without shell=True or implicit shell interpolation.
limitations: No pipelines, redirections, job control or shell expansion in the bridge
External commands must exist on the host
Directory deletion is deliberately not recursive in the bridge

isa_matching.policy: Match host CPU architecture to canonical ISA database IDs; inventory match is not emulator/compiler support.
isa_matching.unsupported_cross_architecture: refuse execution unless a matching decoder/backend and conformance tests are available

operations: open file or URL with host default application
launch a host executable through argument-array process APIs
expose current host ISA and compatibility mode

security: Never pass user commands to subprocess with shell=True
Do not copy proprietary Windows system DLLs
Validate PE headers and architecture before attempting execution
Use OS-native sandboxing/process isolation for untrusted executables
